snippet.title: Apolune 2 Demo trailer
snippet.description:
Apolune 2 is a stand-alone adventure single player and local co-op game set in the asteroid belt. You and your team of astronauts are asteroid miners on a mission to make spacebucks, survive and thrive in deep space. A game by LostAstronaut.com
Play the demo right now! https://www.xbox.com/en-US/games/store/apolune-2-demo/9P50Q8V2S91R
